title: Generation of protein conformations using a simple inverted transformer
abstract: arXiv:2611.19321v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Molecular dynamics is an extremely powerful approach for studying protein behavior, but it requires enormous computational resources to obtain an adequate sampling of possible conformations. Recently, thanks to successes in predicting three-dimensional protein structures, there has been an explosion of research exploring the opportunities offered by deep learning to address the problem of protein conformational landscape. translated_title: 使用简单倒置Transformer生成蛋白质构象
translated_abstract: 分子动力学是研究蛋白质行为的一种极其强大的方法，但要对可能的构象进行充分采样，需要巨大的计算资源。近年来，得益于三维蛋白质结构预测的成功，探索深度学习在解决蛋白质构象景观问题上的应用机会的研究呈爆发式增长。在这项工作中，研究者引入了一种基于Transformer架构变体的人工智能系统，并将其应用于确定蛋白质可及的三维结构集合及其统计权重的问题。在通过经典全原子分子动力学获得的某一特定蛋白质构象数据集上训练后，该神经网络能够直接生成物理上合理的蛋白质构象，其结果与通过分子动力学获得的结果相似。
tldr: 该研究提出一种基于Transformer架构变体的简单人工智能系统，仅需在分子动力学构象数据上训练即可直接生成物理合理的蛋白质构象集合及其统计权重，大幅降低了蛋白质构象采样的计算成本。
en_tdlr: This work introduces a simple AI system based on a variant of the Transformer architecture that, once trained on molecular dynamics conformational data, can directly generate physically plausible protein conformations and their statistical weights, greatly reducing the computational cost of sampling the protein conformational landscape.
